messages:
Maya (marketing): Quick heads-up — we need final fact-check + embargo language for the launch briefings tomorrow. Pasting the doc link and key snippets.

James (PR): Got it. Link pls and who can join the 1:1 analyst calls? I can run EU-friendly slots if needed.

Maya (marketing): Doc: https://docs.google.com/example/launch-factcheck. Key asks from analysts: raw CSVs (sanitized), method notes, and a CEO quote. Also want a demo ask — keep a short runbook.

Sam (legal): I'll review. Immediate flag: drop absolute phrasing like "the fastest". Recommend "consistently low median latency" + pointer to methodology. Also add: "All quotes subject to final legal review." I'll aim to sign by EOD.

Alex (product): Suggest this quote for CEO/PR to use:

"Redwood Inference delivers consistently low median latency across common open-source LLMs, helping teams ship responsive experiences with lower per-token cost."

Alex (product): I'll attach the sanitized perf CSV (no customer IDs) and the methodology note to the doc by 2pm.

James (PR): Love it — I'll craft two CEO variants: one short for general press and one technical for infra analysts. Will post both in the doc.

Lina (comms): For the analyst asks: TechRadar wants a 30m pre-brief; InfraLens asked for CSV + slide export. We should standardize the data package: 1 slide deck, 1 CSV (sanitized), 1 methodology readme.

Nora (ops): I booked 30m slots: Mon 16:00 PT (US-friendly) and Tue 09:00 CET (EU). Invites include "Embargo: do not publish until 2026-04-06 09:00 PT" in the description. Please confirm.

Maya (marketing): Confirmed. Please add the embargo copy from the doc: "Embargo: April 6, 2026 09:00 PT — do not publish." Also include a line about embargo consequences for early publication.

Sam (legal): Small note: change "consequences" phrasing to "please notify PR at press@redwood.com if you have questions about embargo timing." Avoid punitive language.

James (PR): Quick question: share full CSVs proactively or only on request? Pros: transparency. Cons: risk of misinterpretation. Thoughts?

Alex (product): I think share CSVs proactively but with a one-page explainer of how to read the columns and known caveats (sequence lengths, batch config). That should reduce back-and-forth.

Lina (comms): Agreed. Also add a short "how we measured" bullet in the email to analysts so they don't jump to wrong conclusions.

Sam (legal): Approved, as long as CSVs are scrubbed and IP-sensitive annotation removed. I'll check attachments before sends.

James (PR): I'll prepare an email template for analysts that includes the embargo, the data package, CEO quote options, and a note: "Please attribute quotes to Redwood Inference (company) or CEO [Ravi Patel]." Any objection to CEO name?

Maya (marketing): No objection. PR: draft both the generic and technical email variants and drop in the doc.

Ravi (CEO): Happy to give a 1-2 line comment. James — send me the final wording and I'll pick.

EmbargoBot: Automated reminder — embargo set for 2026-04-06 09:00 PT. Do not publish prior to embargo lift.

James (PR): Draft emails posted. Two CEO quote options included. Also included a short demo checklist in case an analyst requests a live demo: 10 min demo, 1-2 screenshots, no customer data.

Nora (ops): Ops note — for demos that need GPUs, use the reserved launch pool. Ping me 3 hours before demo so I can spin capacity.

Alex (product): Uploaded sanitized CSV + methodology readme (see doc comment 9). CSV includes tokenized sequence distribution and median latency columns.

Sam (legal): Reviewing attachments now. One minor edit to the methodology language to ensure we aren't implying validating external models. Done.

Lina (comms): I'll host TechRadar briefing and take notes. If they ask for a deeper demo we'll triage to product.

James (PR): TechRadar confirmed 30m. InfraLens wants an extra 15m follow-up for kernel-level Qs. Alex — can you join that?

Alex (product): Yep — I'll be on InfraLens follow-up.

Maya (marketing): Final checklist:
- Sam: legal signoff on quotes + embargo blurb
- Alex: CSV + methodology doc attached
- James: analyst invites + CEO quote ready
- Lina: host + note-taking
- Nora: ops capacity ready for demos
Reply here when your item is done so I can move to #launch-announce.

Sam (legal): Signed off on quotes and embargo line. Left one micro-comment in the doc about "benchmarked models" phrasing.

Alex (product): CSV + readme uploaded and sanitized. Note added about sequence lengths.

James (PR): CEO picked quote v2 and approved. Sent invites + follow-ups. Will escalate if analysts request raw logs.

Lina (comms): Hosting confirmed and I'll upload notes to the launch folder post-briefing.

Nora (ops): Capacity OK. Will standby for demo requests.

Maya (marketing): Thanks team — Closing thread and moving final doc to the press kit. If any embargo slips, ping me immediately.
